scope: Native AVR8js main-thread execution before OPT-009

observations.scheduler: A 16 ms setInterval runs a synchronous fixed batch whenever simulation is running, unpaused, and board power is available
observations.batchSize: Each interval executes exactly 25,000 avrInstruction and cpu.tick pairs
observations.wallTimeBudget: The instruction loop has no performance deadline or yield check
observations.clockReconciliation: Batch size is not derived from elapsed wall time, CPU cycles, simulation speed, or delayed frames
observations.stallBehavior: Background-tab and main-thread stalls rely on interval behavior without an explicit bounded catch-up policy
observations.fidelityMode: Adaptive and Full fidelity affect the MNA worker but do not change AVR scheduling
observations.diagnostics: No AVR instruction rate, emulated clock rate, slice duration, utilization, retained cycle debt, or budget-limited status is exposed

limitation: Compiled-firmware browser frame-time and input-latency traces were unavailable; validate deterministic cycle partitioning and responsiveness through OPT-FB-010.
